text: Thanks, will you bite that in the ass for me and write those in as priority concerns all of those that codex decided to leave absent
resolution: Backfilled the three design concerns that codex dropped from DESIGN_INTAKE.md, found by validating req_2168 plus/minus 5 against the doc. Added PRIORITY-flagged sections, faithful to the source request text and each citing its req id: Model Package Layout (req_2168) describing a model as a self-contained directory holding mesh data, a per-decomposition texture atlas for LoD and explosion break-up, arbitrarily many stored paint variations, and copied shader-code references, with global shader/image textures kept separate and copy-the-folder carrying everything end to end; Overlays Must Block Pointer Events behind them (req_2167) as a framework-level fix; and host-run pre-open Layout Reachability Validation in zig/ts with no python (req_2171/2172). Cross-referenced the Skeleton Object Model doc and the existing layoutValidateCli.ts. Note: the commit swept in pre-existing uncommitted doc additions on the same file (302 insertions total), all additive, nothing destroyed.
